facts.claim: Riviera (Oceania Cruises): Entered service 2012; 66,084 GT; 1250 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 239 m length; Oceania class.
Riviera is an Italian word which means 'coastline', ultimately derived from Latin rīpa, through Ligurian rivêa.
It came to be applied as a proper name to the coast of Liguria in the form Riviera ligure, then shortened in English.

catalogSpecs.description: Operated by Oceania Cruises; entered service 2012; 70,000 GT; approx. 1,250 guests.
